desc: Derive the finite-field cancellation formula and special cases (p=1, p=2, odd p corrections).
Implement input parsing, zero count K, and p==1/p==2 special outputs.
Implement optimized modular matrix multiplication and binary exponentiation for A^p mod p.
Apply corrections for zero diagonal cells and p==3 off-diagonal cells, multiply by (-1)^K, and print result.
Validate against samples and small brute-force cases (p=2, p=3, p=5; diagonal/off-diagonal/mixed zeros).
